* [JENKINS-73695](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73695) - BUG: Dashboard shows white space on certain width space >900px (#9667) @scherler

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Add doCheckDisplayNameOrNull to jenkins core (#9150) @krisstern

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-73170](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73170) - Upgrade Commons FileUpload from 1.5 to 2.0.0-M2 (#9259) @basil
* move the header parts in a taglib (#9223) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-73158](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73158) - avoid jumping layout due to tooltips (#9263) @mawinter69

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-73166](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73166) - Fix PKCS#12 certificate save to credentials (#9286) @zbynek
* [JENKINS-73168](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73168) - Restore 'No changes' label when there are no changes in a build (#9283) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-73156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73156) - handle svg cleanup of symbols via an xml document (#9266) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72622](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72622) - Rename CloudSet query parameter to avoid conflict (#9198) @Dohbedoh
* [JENKINS-73090](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73090) - Handle CR from `LineTransformationOutputStream` (#9219) @jglick
* [JENKINS-73114](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73114) - avoid conflicts with css classes from bootstrap (#9254) @mawinter69

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* [JENKINS-72622](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72622) - Rename CloudSet query parameter to avoid conflict (#9198) @Dohbedoh
* move the header parts in a taglib (#9223) @mawinter69
* Ensure `ClassLoader`s have names for debugging (#9277) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-73114](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73114) - avoid conflicts with css classes from bootstrap (#9254) @mawinter69

## 📝 Documentation updates

* Clarify artifacts permission description (#9276) @Kevin-CB

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump stapler.version from 1863.vd250086e9885 to 1869.v3605a_771fb_e3 (#9291) @dependabot

All contributors: @Dohbedoh, @Kevin-CB, @Vlatombe, @basil, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @janfaracik, @jenkins-release-bot, @jglick, @jtnord, @mawinter69, @renovate, @renovate[bot] and @zbynek

* Bump io.jenkins.plugins:design-library from 286.v6643a_81e02b_8 to 296.v56576267b_508 (#9154) @dependabot

l_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jenkinsci/jenkins/zipball/jenkins-2.459","body":"_This ## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-73170](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73170) - Upgrade Commons FileUpload from 1.5 to 2.0.0-M2 (#9259) @basil
* move the header parts in a taglib (#9223) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-73158](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73158) - avoid jumping layout due to tooltips (#9263) @mawinter69

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-73166](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73166) - Fix PKCS#12 certificate save to credentials (#9286) @zbynek
* [JENKINS-73168](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73168) - Restore 'No changes' label when there are no changes in a build (#9283) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-73156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73156) - handle svg cleanup of symbols via an xml document (#9266) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72622](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72622) - Rename CloudSet query parameter to avoid conflict (#9198) @Dohbedoh
* [JENKINS-73090](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73090) - Handle CR from `LineTransformationOutputStream` (#9219) @jglick
* [JENKINS-73114](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73114) - avoid conflicts with css classes from bootstrap (#9254) @mawinter69

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* [JENKINS-72622](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72622) - Rename CloudSet query parameter to avoid conflict (#9198) @Dohbedoh
* move the header parts in a taglib (#9223) @mawinter69
* Ensure `ClassLoader`s have names for debugging (#9277) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-73114](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-73114) - avoid conflicts with css classes from bootstrap (#9254) @mawinter69

## 📝 Documentation updates

* Clarify artifacts permission description (#9276) @Kevin-CB

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump stapler.version from 1863.vd250086e9885 to 1869.v3605a_771fb_e3 (#9291) @dependabot

All contributors: @Dohbedoh, @Kevin-CB, @Vlatombe, @basil, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @janfaracik, @jenkins-release-bot, @jglick, @jtnord, @mawinter69, @renovate, @renovate[bot] and @zbynek
